plan.title: Add PR Line to Draft Project

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enables the configured capability required to add a PR line to a draft project.
Opens the Purchase Requisitions area as the required starting screen.
Ensures the selectable PR is on the Open tab.
Selects an open material PR containing one line item.
Opens the selected PR's Purchase Items actions.

args.goal: Click Add to Draft Project for the selected PR line, choose the existing draft project, then open that draft from Events > Drafts; stop on the draft create screen showing the PR line as an extra item, retaining the PR quantity and indicating that the PR line belongs to this project

steps.note: Performs the Add to Draft Project action and opens the resulting draft, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Asserts that the opened draft displays the PR line with its API-backed quantity.
